test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 6 Oct 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Archit starts from Point A and drives 6 km towards the east. He then takes a left turn, drives 24 km, turns right and drives 8 km. He then takes a right turn and drives 12 km. He takes a final right turn, drives 14 km and stops at Point B. How far and towards which direction should he drive in order to reach Point A from Point B? (All turns are 90 degree turns only)
solution:
Given: All turns are 90 degree turns only

Archit starts from Point A and drives 6 km towards the east.

He then takes a left turn, drives 24 km, turns right and drives 8 km.

He then takes a right turn and drives 12 km.

He takes a final right turn, drives 14 km and stops at Point B.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d8a2c1e7fa35e6fa2e9a3f35de94e7ee0391ff2d14251f15d739a9e97aa2a1bb.png] 

Thus, Archit should drive 12 km in the south direction to reach Point A from Point B.

Hence, "Option 1" is the correct answer.
